lines.text: Paul says terrible times will come in the last days, when men will love themselves and money.
Men will be unforgiving, brutal, reckless, conceited, and have a form of godliness while denying its power.
These men worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women weighed down with sins.
The women are always learning, and the men oppose the truth just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Aaron.
Paul says these men's folly will be pleasing to everyone, just like that of Jannes and Jambres.
